app.name: ZidMapa
app.tagline: Report graffiti and help keep the city clean

map.notConfigured: Database not configured yet: add your Supabase keys to .env.local.

capture.heading: Take a photo of the graffiti
capture.error: Couldn't read this photo. Try another one.
capture.privacy: Location data is removed from the photo before upload. Please don't photograph people.

locate.heading: Where is it?
locate.hint: Drag the pin to the exact spot.
locate.noLocation: We couldn't get your location. Tap the map to place the pin.
locate.outside: Reports are only accepted within Serbia.

nearby.heading: Is it one of these?
nearby.hint: These were already reported within {m} m. If it's the same graffiti, confirm it instead of creating a new report.

details.heading: Almost done
details.notePlaceholder: e.g. side wall, about 2 m high

errors.rate_limited: Too many reports in a short time. Please try again later.
errors.outside: Reports are only accepted within Serbia.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

done.heading: Thank you!
done.body: Your report is on the map. A cleaning team will take care of it.
done.confirmedBody: Thanks for confirming – this spot now has a higher priority.

login.heading: Log in
login.body: You don't need an account to report graffiti. Logging in is for admins and for keeping track of your own reports.
login.sent: Check your email and open the login link.
login.error: Couldn't send the link. Please try again.

admin.heading: Admin
admin.needLogin: Log in to access the admin page.
admin.notAdmin: This account is not an admin.
